This App is fantastic! The concept is amazing, the execution is not great.. I really love this app! I use it all the time to make better decisions. I’m trying to implement better routines and product usage for myself. Most of the high-end products I purchase are NOT in the app, which is totally fine. I scan, photograph and add them myself and WAIT for them to be added. Most of the time the products are added after a couple days. 20% of the time they don’t get added. No problem, I just resubmit, they get added. HOWEVER, the names of the products never get added so they’re not actually being added to the database for OTHER people. The beauty of an app like this is you’re getting OTHER PEOPLE to populate your database FOR YOU. Why you would want to charge someone $14.99 a year to do that, I don’t understand. In order to add product names yourself you must be an annual subscriber. So you’re kinda missing the boat on actually adding product information to your database that would most likely be useful for other people. People can’t search for a product by name and get a hit on information a user has added, there’s no name. Having said that, I personally would want to retain control of adding products and product titles to ensure they are being titled methodically, accurately, responsibly and in a uniform matter. But don’t sleep on this app, it’s great!!
